field_contracts.trial_id: exact canonical ID C01-T01 through C12-T40; unique
field_contracts.colony_id: C01 through C12; must exactly equal the C## colony prefix encoded by trial_id and exactly match one frozen colony-husbandry record
field_contracts.ant_id: nonempty observed identity; unique across planned trials unless exclusion_reason is verified_wrong_species_or_duplicate_ant_identity, in which case preserve the observed repeated/invalid identity rather than inventing a unique replacement
field_contracts.session_id: nonempty string; must match exactly one chemical session-use record and exactly one video/calibration session record
field_contracts.video_file_id: for a usable video session, nonempty string exactly matching that session's video_file_id; null only when that session has video_capture_status=failed and this trial is a verified video/tracking technical exclusion
field_contracts.scorer_identity: nonempty string; must exactly match scorer_identity in the trial's session_id video/calibration record
field_contracts.marked_side_randomization_code: L or R and must match frozen marked-side schedule
field_contracts.collection_order: integer 1..480 matching actual chronological attempt order
field_contracts.trial_start_timestamp: ISO-8601 local timestamp with offset; all 40 planned trials sharing a colony_id must have the same local YYYY-MM-DD date, equal the joined colony-husbandry test_date_local, and fall 2 through 10 hours after that record's test_day_lights_on_timestamp_local
field_contracts.pheromone_batch_id: nonempty batch record reference; must exactly equal batch_id on the unique chemical session-use record joined by session_id
field_contracts.application_to_release_delay_s: number in [105,135] if release_occurred=true; null only when a preregistered technical exclusion aborts the attempt before release
field_contracts.scheduled_release_x_mm: must exactly match frozen release-pose schedule
field_contracts.scheduled_release_y_mm: must exactly match frozen release-pose schedule
field_contracts.scheduled_release_heading_rad: must exactly match frozen release-pose schedule
field_contracts.release_occurred: boolean recording whether the ant physically crossed the launch-channel exit plane and therefore had a biological t=0
field_contracts.t0_pose_measurement_available: boolean; true only when calibrated video permits measured x/y/heading at biological t=0
field_contracts.measured_release_x_mm: number from calibrated video at t=0 when t0_pose_measurement_available=true; otherwise null
field_contracts.measured_release_y_mm: number from calibrated video at t=0 when t0_pose_measurement_available=true; otherwise null
field_contracts.measured_release_heading_rad: number from thorax/mesosoma-to-head vector at t=0 when t0_pose_measurement_available=true; otherwise null
field_contracts.release_position_error_mm: Euclidean distance from scheduled x/y when t0_pose_measurement_available=true; otherwise null; compliant iff numeric value <=0.2
field_contracts.release_heading_error_rad: absolute normalized angular error when t0_pose_measurement_available=true; otherwise null; compliant iff numeric value <=0.025
field_contracts.left_terminal_first_entry_time_s: null or earliest interpolated entry time in [0,90]
field_contracts.right_terminal_first_entry_time_s: null or earliest interpolated entry time in [0,90]
field_contracts.scored_choice: derived field: left, right, or null under consistency_rules; never manually assigned contrary to entry times
field_contracts.timeout: derived boolean under consistency_rules; timeouts are never exclusions
field_contracts.exclusion_reason: null or one exact allowed exclusion reason
field_contracts.protocol_deviation: null or text; never silently discard deviations
field_contracts.worker_assay_naive_before_trial: boolean; must be true for promotion-grade execution, attesting before release that this worker has never previously been exposed to this replication assay; false must be preserved as a protocol deviation and may not be converted into a new exclusion reason
field_contracts.substrate_piece_id: nonempty immutable identifier for the individual paper overlay used in this trial; unique across all 480 planned trials
field_contracts.fresh_substrate_installed_for_trial: boolean; true only when a new unused paper overlay identified by substrate_piece_id was installed for this trial
field_contracts.reusable_maze_base_cleaned_with_70_perce: boolean recording whether the reusable maze base was cleaned with 70 percent ethanol before this trial
field_contracts.reusable_maze_base_fully_dry_before_fres: boolean recording whether the ethanol-cleaned reusable maze base was fully dry before the fresh paper overlay was installed

consistency_rules: behavior-based exclusion is forbidden
colony_id must exactly equal the C## colony prefix encoded by trial_id; a trial record may never be reassigned to another colony

colony_id must join exactly one frozen colony-husbandry record; that record must satisfy the preregistered wild-source, distinct-source-nest, acclimation, feeding, 96 plus or minus 2 hour deprivation, water, 12:12 light cycle, lights-on test-window, and no-food-reward contracts

for each colony_id, the local YYYY-MM-DD date parsed from trial_start_timestamp must be identical across all 40 planned trial records and equal the joined colony-husbandry test_date_local; a colony may not be split across multiple test days
every trial_start_timestamp must be at least 2 hours and at most 10 hours after the joined colony-husbandry record's test_day_lights_on_timestamp_local

session_id must join the trial to exactly one chemical session-use record in exactly one chemical batch and exactly one video/calibration session record; scorer_identity must exactly match that video/calibration record
pheromone_batch_id must exactly equal the batch_id stored on the unique chemical session-use record joined by session_id, and that session-use batch_id must equal its parent master-stock batch_id
if the joined video/calibration record has video_capture_status=usable then video_file_id must be nonempty and exactly match that session record's video_file_id

if the joined video/calibration record has video_capture_status=failed then video_file_id may be null only when exclusion_flag=true and exclusion_reason=verified_video_or_tracking_failure_preventing_endpoint_determination; never fabricate a video ID, hash, or timestamps

worker_assay_naive_before_trial must be true for a promotion-grade conforming trial and must be attested before release; a false value is a preserved protocol deviation, is not an allowed technical exclusion, and does not authorize replacement
substrate_piece_id must be unique across all 480 planned trials; reuse of a paper overlay is forbidden

for a promotion-grade conforming trial, fresh_substrate_installed_for_trial, reusable_maze_base_cleaned_with_70_percent_ethanol_before_trial, and reusable_maze_base_fully_dry_before_fresh_substrate_installation must all be true; any false value must be preserved in protocol_deviation and may not be silently excluded or replaced
timeouts are not exclusions
technical exclusions are absent from choice and timeout denominators but remain fully reported
if exclusion_flag=true then exclusion_reason must be one exact allowed exclusion reason, scored_choice must be null, and timeout must be false
if exclusion_flag=false then exclusion_reason must be null, release_occurred must be true, and t0_pose_measurement_available must be true

if release_occurred=false then application_to_release_delay_s, measured_release_x_mm, measured_release_y_mm, measured_release_heading_rad, release_position_error_mm, release_heading_error_rad, left_terminal_first_entry_time_s, and right_terminal_first_entry_time_s must all be null; exclusion_flag must be true; scored_choice must be null; timeout must be false

if t0_pose_measurement_available=false then measured_release_x_mm, measured_release_y_mm, measured_release_heading_rad, release_position_error_mm, and release_heading_error_rad must all be null and exclusion_flag must be true; never fabricate unavailable measurements
if t0_pose_measurement_available=true then measured_release_x_mm, measured_release_y_mm, measured_release_heading_rad, release_position_error_mm, and release_heading_error_rad must all be numeric
if exclusion_flag=false and both terminal first-entry times are null then scored_choice must be null and timeout must be true
if exclusion_flag=false and exactly one terminal first-entry time is non-null then scored_choice must equal that terminal side and timeout must be false
if exclusion_flag=false and both terminal first-entry times are non-null then scored_choice must equal the side with the strictly earlier first-entry time and timeout must be false

if both terminal first-entry times are non-null and equal or otherwise cannot yield a unique earliest terminal, classify a verified_video_or_tracking_failure_preventing_endpoint_determination technical exclusion rather than manually choosing a side; null/null is a timeout state, not an equal-entry exclusion

if release_position_error_mm is numeric and > 0.2 or release_heading_error_rad is numeric and > 0.025 then exclusion_flag must be true and exclusion_reason must equal verified_release_pose_outside_preregistered_tolerance_scored_before_endpoint_and_without_treatment_unblinding

if exclusion_reason equals verified_release_pose_outside_preregistered_tolerance_scored_before_endpoint_and_without_treatment_unblinding then release_occurred and t0_pose_measurement_available must both be true, release_position_error_mm and release_heading_error_rad must both be numeric, and release_position_error_mm > 0.2 or release_heading_error_rad > 0.025 must be true
if exclusion_reason equals verified_wrong_species_or_duplicate_ant_identity, preserve the observed ant_id even when it duplicates an earlier ant_id; do not synthesize a unique replacement identity
release-pose compliance must be assessed before endpoint scoring and without marked-side/Candidate access
no adaptive replacement of failed or timeout trials
dataset_freeze_rule: After all planned attempts and preregistered records are complete, serialize the complete raw trial dataset, compute and record its cryptographic hash, and freeze that hash before Candidate-307 comparison is unblinded or calculated.
